lines.heard: X sits in the power. So, take ln of both sides. LNY equals minus NX plus LNA.
lines.said: X sits in the power, so take L N of both sides. L N Y equals minus N X plus L N A.

lines.heard: unlog the intercept LNA is -1. So A is E to the power -1.
lines.said: Un-log the intercept. L N A is minus one, so A is E to the power minus one.
